meta.name: amazon-product-research
meta.description: Comprehensive product research and opportunity analysis for Amazon sellers. Analyzes demand, competition, profit potential, market entry barriers, and validates product ideas. Covers product sourcing, pricing strategy, and go-to-market planning. Use when the user asks about researching a product to sell, validating product ideas, product opportunity analysis, market research for Amazon, competition analysis, profit potential, should I sell this product, product viability, or any general product research questions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析亚马逊市场机会，验证产品盈利潜力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在亚马逊上寻找有利润空间的新产品
copy.tagline_en: Analyze Amazon market opportunities and validate product profit potential
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are looking for profitable new products to sell on Amazon

howto.what: 当用户询问亚马逊选品时，Claude 会进行全面的产品研究，包括需求分析、竞争评估、利润计算和市场进入策略，并输出一份详细的评分报告。
howto.when: 当用户提出关于亚马逊产品研究的问题时触发，例如询问“这个产品值得卖吗？”或要求分析某个产品的市场机会。

say.text: 帮我研究一下无线耳机在亚马逊上的市场机会。
say.note: Claude 会分析需求、竞争和利润潜力。

say.text: 瑜伽垫在亚马逊上卖得好吗？
say.note: Claude 会评估产品可行性并给出评分。

say.text: 比较手机壳和手机支架哪个更适合在亚马逊上卖。
say.note: Claude 会生成对比表格并推荐最佳选择。

howto.what_en: When asked about Amazon product research, Claude performs comprehensive analysis including demand, competition, profit potential, and market entry strategy, outputting a detailed scored report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about researching a product to sell on Amazon, validating product ideas, or analyzing market opportunities.

say_en.text: Research wireless earbuds as a product opportunity on Amazon.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes demand, competition, and profit.

say_en.text: Is selling yoga mats on Amazon a good idea?
say_en.note: Claude evaluates viability and scores it.

say_en.text: Compare phone cases vs phone stands for Amazon selling.
say_en.note: Claude generates a comparison table and recommendation.
